name: cache-timer
description: Shows when the prompt cache expires, with an optional, tightly limited /keepwarm.

style.title: Cache timer style
style.description: fuse (a draining bar), rule (a colored line above the prompt), or ember (a glyph beside the spinner)

maxLines.title: Band height
maxLines.description: Lines the timer may use above the prompt, 1 to 3

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto detects it from Claude Code's usage reports (5 minutes or 1 hour). Choose 5m or 1h to pin it.

debug.title: Debug log lines
debug.description: Write diagnostic lines to the debug log (claude --debug-file)

keepwarmEnabled.title: Allow /keepwarm
keepwarmEnabled.description: Lets /keepwarm send small pings that spend tokens to keep the cache alive while you are away. Off by default.

keepwarmDefaultMinutes.title: /keepwarm default minutes
keepwarmDefaultMinutes.description: Duration when /keepwarm is run with no number

keepwarmMaxMinutes.title: /keepwarm maximum minutes
keepwarmMaxMinutes.description: Longest single /keepwarm run. A session may use at most twice this in total.

keepwarmMaxPings.title: /keepwarm maximum pings
keepwarmMaxPings.description: Most pings one /keepwarm run may send

keepwarmMaxSpendUsd.title: /keepwarm maximum spend (USD)
keepwarmMaxSpendUsd.description: Stops /keepwarm once its pings have cost this much
